rationale: Newly registered trainer reconstructs the architectural class that historically cleared 5/7 windows at 46-50% WR / 5-10% DD (#278/#284/#286, recorded in feedback DB but source lost in pyc-only state). Default conf_lambda=0.5 already shows the variance-reduction premise works (W6 cleared at 51.6% WR / 5.2% DD, the lowest DD of any iter since #286) but blows out W1/W3 by clipping too many bag-disagreement rows to score=0, which pulls the threshold sweep into thr=0.0 top-K-per-day mode. Train mode should prioritise sweeping conf_lambda → [0.0, 0.3] (drop the consensus penalty so ev_gate discrimination survives), ev_floor → [0.2, 0.5] (higher floor lifts negative-EV days above the abstain cliff so the threshold sweep doesn't collapse to 0 in noisy regimes — same direction the prior active_case called out), and n_bags ∈ {5, 7} jointly with the existing tree HPs.
